title: Balon Lavaş (Turkish Balloon Bread)
steps: Dissolve the yeast in the tablespoon of lukewarm water and set aside for about 10 minutes.

Mix flour and salt, make a well in the center and add the dissolved yeast. Gradually mix in the flour and 250 ml water, kneading to a soft, moist, non-sticky dough. Shape into a ball and let rise in a covered bowl at room temperature for 90 minutes.

Place a baking stone on the middle rack. Set the oven to 275 degrees with top and bottom heat; preheat the stone for about an hour. The source does not specify the temperature unit; see the review note.
Whisk the egg yolk with 1 Tbsp water. Flour the work surface generously, knead the dough again and divide into 8 pieces. Roll each into a circle about 3 mm thick and 12–15 cm across.
Brush the center of each bread with egg wash and sprinkle with sesame and nigella. Slide onto the hot stone and close the oven door.

Bake until puffed: a lightly browned surface gives a softer bread, while additional browning produces a crisp bread. The source does not specify a baking time. Repeat with the remaining dough and serve warm.
reviewFlags: The source states an oven temperature of 275 degrees without specifying Fahrenheit or Celsius, and does not give a baking time. Confirm both before baking.
